cases.prompt: Freeze edits so I only touch the src/billing folder this session.

assertions.text: Restricts file edits to the specified directory for the session
Blocks Edit and Write outside the allowed path via the PreToolUse freeze check

cases.prompt: 이 폴더만 수정하게 잠가줘. 다른 코드 건드리지 않게.

assertions.text: Produces a session-scoped edit boundary restriction
Prevents accidentally editing unrelated code outside the chosen module

cases.prompt: Freeze edits to E:/work/app/src. My session cwd is inside src, so will an Edit to the Windows path of E:/work/app/README.md still be allowed?

assertions.text: Explains that Windows drive paths (backslash or forward-slash form) and /e/ paths are normalized to one form and compared case-insensitively before the boundary check.
States that an Edit outside the boundary is denied even when the session cwd is inside the boundary, and that relative paths are denied rather than joined to the cwd.
Runs the hook through bash "$HOME/.claude/skills/freeze/bin/check-freeze.sh" because ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} is unset in frontmatter hooks.

cases.prompt: freeze 설정하는데 FREEZE_BUSY 가 나왔어. 잠긴 거야?

assertions.text: Explains that FREEZE_BUSY from freeze-state.sh means another writer holds the state lock and the boundary was NOT changed or set.
Retries once and otherwise shows the user the .freeze-mutation.lock directory instead of deleting it on its own.
